name: LobsterPay
description: Permissioned payment layer for AI agents on Solana. Make payments, swaps, and x402 purchases through a policy-controlled vault — no private keys needed.

auth.instructions: Use the API key provided by the vault owner. Format: Bearer lp_live_xxxxx

tools.name: check_vault
tools.description: Check your vault status, token balances, and effective spending permissions. Call this first to understand what actions are allowed and how much budget remains.

response.balances: Array of token balances held by the vault. Each entry: { mint, symbol (nullable), amount (atomic string), uiAmount (number), decimals }. Empty array if vault holds no tokens yet.

permissions.maxPerTxAmountAtomic: Max amount per single transaction (atomic units)
permissions.dailyLimitAmountAtomic: Max total spend per day (atomic units)
permissions.maxSlippageBps: Max allowed slippage for swaps (basis points)

tools.name: make_payment
tools.description: Send tokens from the vault to an approved destination. The vault owner sets which destinations, mints, and amounts are allowed. All payments are idempotent — safe to retry with the same idempotencyKey.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: SPL token mint address. Common: USDC = EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v

parameters.name: amountAtomic
parameters.description: Amount in atomic units. For USDC (6 decimals): 1000000 = 1.00 USDC, 500000 = 0.50 USDC

parameters.name: destinationOwner
parameters.description: Solana wallet address of the payment recipient

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string (e.g. 'invoice-123') only if you want to make retries safe — sending the same key with the same body won't double-charge. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

parameters.name: memo
parameters.description: Optional memo describing the payment purpose

tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a quote for swapping one token for another through a DEX aggregator. Returns expected output, price impact, and route. Does NOT execute — call execute_swap to proceed.

parameters.name: fromMint
parameters.description: Input token mint address

parameters.name: toMint
parameters.description: Output token mint address

parameters.name: amountAtomic
parameters.description: Input amount in atomic units

parameters.name: maxSlippageBps
parameters.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default: 100 (1%)

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Execute a token swap through the DEX aggregator. Subject to vault policy limits. Get a quote first to preview.

parameters.name: fromMint
parameters.description: Input token mint address

parameters.name: toMint
parameters.description: Output token mint address

parameters.name: amountAtomic
parameters.description: Input amount in atomic units

parameters.name: maxSlippageBps
parameters.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default: 100 (1%)

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string only if you want safe retries. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

tools.name: pay_x402
tools.description: Pay a 402-gated HTTP endpoint. When you get a 402 Payment Required, pass the paymentRequirements here; we validate against vault policy, settle the SPL transfer on-chain, and return a Solana tx signature plus an xPaymentHeader you can attach to the retry against originalRequestUrl so the upstream API releases the content.

parameters.name: paymentRequirements
parameters.description: Payment requirements from the 402 response. Must include: scheme ('exact'), network, asset (mint address), amount (atomic units), recipient (destination wallet). The `network` field accepts any of: 'solana' (cluster-agnostic, resolves to the server's configured cluster), 'solana-devnet', 'solana-mainnet', 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (CAIP-2 mainnet, per x402 spec), 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (CAIP-2 devnet). The server rejects cluster-specific values that don't match its own cluster. Optional: paymentId for upstream dedup, expiresAt as an ISO string.

parameters.name: originalRequestUrl
parameters.description: The URL that returned the 402 response. Used for domain-based policy checks + audit trail.

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string only if you want safe retries. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

response.txSignature: Solana transaction signature (null until tx confirms)
response.paymentId: The upstream paymentId if the 402 included one
response.xPaymentHeader: Base64-encoded JSON proof the agent SHOULD set as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (or legacy X-PAYMENT) when retrying originalRequestUrl. Shape is the x402 v2 envelope: { x402Version: 2, scheme: 'exact', network, payload: { txSignature, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, amount, recipient, paymentId } }. `maxAmountRequired`/`payTo` are the v2 names; `amount`/`recipient` are included as back-compat aliases so upstream paywalls reading either work.
response.grossAmount: Amount paid in atomic units (same as paymentRequirements.amount)
response.netAmount: Amount the recipient actually received (gross minus the 1.5% service fee, enforced on-chain)
response.serviceFee: 1.5% service fee in atomic units, routed to the LobsterPay treasury

x402_retry_flow: 1. Agent GETs the paywalled URL, gets a 402 with paymentRequirements in the body. In x402 v2, the body is { x402Version: 2, accepts: [ { scheme, network, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, ... } ] }. Pass accepts[0] (or the legacy flat paymentRequirements alias if present) to pay_x402.

2. Agent forwards paymentRequirements intact to pay_x402 along with originalRequestUrl. The 402's `network` field is typically a CAIP-2 chain id like 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (devnet) or 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (mainnet). Both are accepted. The server rejects cluster-specific values that don't match its own configured cluster.
3. On status: confirmed, agent retries the original URL with header 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <xPaymentHeader>' (or legacy 'X-PAYMENT: <xPaymentHeader>' for older upstreams).
4. Upstream API verifies the Solana tx signature (by looking it up on-chain) and returns 200 + content.

compatibility.works_with: Upstream paywalled APIs that verify by looking up the Solana tx signature on-chain (amount + recipient + mint against getTransaction). Our own /v1/demo/x402/fortune and /v1/demo/x402/joke are reference implementations.
compatibility.for_facilitator_gateways: If the 402 came from a spec-conformant x402 facilitator gateway (agonx402, Coinbase reference facilitator) and contains `extra.feePayer` — use `pay_x402_facilitator` instead of `pay_x402`. Facilitator gateways verify a pre-signed unsubmitted v0 transferChecked tx from the payer's ATA, which `pay_x402_facilitator` produces via a two-tx passthrough: vault → relayer's USDC ATA via execute_pay_exact, then relayer → facilitator's payTo via transferChecked in a v0 tx returned to the agent for the retry.
compatibility.for_siwx_routes: If the 402's `accepts` array is empty AND it carries a Sign-In-with-X CAIP-122 challenge in `extensions['sign-in-with-x']` (e.g. agon's Tokens API, /v1/x402/tokens/...) — use `pay_x402_siwx` instead. These routes don't take payment; they gate access on a wallet signature.

tools.name: pay_x402_facilitator
tools.description: Pay a 402-gated endpoint whose 402 response came from a spec-conformant x402 facilitator gateway (agonx402, Coinbase reference facilitator, etc.). Unlike `pay_x402` (which settles on-chain and returns a tx signature), this tool returns a pre-signed unsubmitted v0 transferChecked transaction in a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE-ready envelope; the facilitator co-signs as fee payer and submits after upstream returns 200. Internally does two txs: (1) LobsterPay-submitted vault → relayer via execute_pay_exact (1.5% service fee applies), (2) relayer → facilitator partial-signed and returned. Use this when the 402 includes `extra.feePayer`; otherwise use `pay_x402`.

parameters.name: paymentRequirements
parameters.description: Payment requirements from the facilitator's 402 response. MUST include `extra.feePayer` (base58 Solana pubkey — the facilitator publishes this; same pubkey is usually also `payTo`). Standard fields: scheme ('exact'), network (CAIP-2 chain id), asset (mint), amount (atomic), payTo. Forward the facilitator's accepts[0] object intact.

parameters.name: originalRequestUrl
parameters.description: The facilitator-gateway URL that returned the 402. Used for domain-based policy checks + audit trail.

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Server generates one if omitted. Note: because each partial tx is tied to a specific blockhash (~60-90s window), retrying with the SAME idempotencyKey after expiry returns the stale request row, not a new tx — call with a fresh idempotencyKey instead.

response.paymentId: Upstream paymentId if the 402 included one
response.paymentSignatureHeader: Base64-encoded x402 v2 envelope. PUT THIS in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header of your retry against originalRequestUrl, with the SAME body as the original request. Shape: { x402Version: 2, accepted: <same requirements object you passed in>, payload: { transaction: <base64 v0 tx> } }. Verified working against agonx402 - see `verified_against` below.
response.partialTransactionBase64: Raw base64 of the v0 tx (inside `paymentSignatureHeader.payload.transaction`). Exposed for debugging.
response.tx1Signature: Solana signature of the on-chain settlement tx (vault → relayer). Useful for auditing.
response.feePayer: Echo of the facilitator's fee-payer pubkey we set in tx2.
response.authority: LobsterPay relayer pubkey — the signer that partial-signed tx2 as transferChecked authority.
response.blockhash: recentBlockhash baked into tx2. Facilitator must submit before it expires.
response.lastValidBlockHeight: Authoritative submit deadline. After this slot, tx2 is permanently invalid.
response.grossAmount: Atomic amount pulled from your vault (agonAmount + 1.5% service fee).
response.agonAmount: Atomic amount the facilitator actually receives.
response.serviceFee: 1.5% service fee in atomic units, routed to the LobsterPay treasury.

facilitator_retry_flow: 1. Agent hits the facilitator-gateway URL, gets a 402. paymentRequirements live in the `Payment-Required` RESPONSE HEADER as base64-encoded JSON (the body is typically just `{ok:false,error:'Payment required'}` and DOES NOT contain the requirements). Decode: `JSON.parse(atob(response.headers.get('Payment-Required')))`. The decoded object is shaped like `{ x402Version: 2, accepts: [{...}] }`. The accepts[0] entry MUST include `extra.feePayer` - that's how you know it's facilitator-mode (and that field is what distinguishes facilitator-style 402s from settled-proof-style ones).
2. Agent calls pay_x402_facilitator with `paymentRequirements = accepts[0]` and `originalRequestUrl`.
3. LobsterPay validates vault policy, runs tx1 (execute_pay_exact vault → relayer) on-chain - 1.5% of gross routes to our treasury - and returns `paymentSignatureHeader` plus metadata.
4. Agent retries the original URL with header `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <paymentSignatureHeader>` (and the SAME body as the original request).

5. Facilitator verifies the partial tx, forwards the request upstream, co-signs as feePayer, submits tx2 on-chain, and returns 200 + the upstream response plus a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header containing the submitted tx signature (base64 JSON: { success, transaction, network, payer }). Decode it the same way as Payment-Required if you want the audit trail.
6. If the facilitator fails to submit within the blockhash window (~60-90s), the partial tx is dead. Call pay_x402_facilitator again with a fresh idempotencyKey for a new tx2.

tools.name: pay_x402_siwx
tools.description: Authenticate to a SIWX-gated x402 endpoint (no payment, no on-chain settlement). Some upstreams — e.g. agon's Tokens API at /v1/x402/tokens/... — return 402 with `accepts: []` and a Sign-In-with-X CAIP-122 challenge in `extensions['sign-in-with-x']` instead of an x402 payment scheme. LobsterPay signs the canonical SIWS message with the relayer ed25519 keypair and returns a base64 `signInWithXHeader` you put in the `SIGN-IN-WITH-X` header on the retry. The signature is single-use and valid for ~300s. Use `pay_x402` or `pay_x402_facilitator` for upstreams that take payment instead.

parameters.name: paymentRequiredHeader
parameters.description: Raw base64 value of the upstream's `Payment-Required` response header — easiest path: just forward the header you got. Either this or `siwxChallenge` is required.

parameters.name: siwxChallenge
parameters.description: Already-decoded SIWX extension (`extensions['sign-in-with-x']` from the 402). Use this if you've already parsed the header. Either this or `paymentRequiredHeader` is required.

parameters.name: originalRequestUrl
parameters.description: The SIWX-gated URL that returned the 402. Used for the audit trail and policy checks.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: CAIP-2 chainId to assert against (e.g. 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' for devnet). Must be in the upstream's `supportedChains[].chainId`. Defaults to the first ed25519 chain in the challenge.

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Server generates one if omitted. Each SIWS signature is single-use anyway — retrying produces a fresh signature.

response.signInWithXHeader: Base64-encoded SIWX payload — put this in the `SIGN-IN-WITH-X` header of your retry against originalRequestUrl, with the SAME method + body. Verified working against agonx402's Tokens API.
response.address: LobsterPay relayer pubkey that signed the challenge.
response.chainId: CAIP-2 chain id the signature is bound to.
response.expirationTime: ISO timestamp of the signature's expiry (typically ~300s after issue).

siwx_retry_flow: 1. Agent hits the SIWX-gated URL, gets a 402. Decode the `Payment-Required` RESPONSE HEADER (base64 JSON). The decoded object has `accepts: []` (no payment scheme) and a CAIP-122 challenge in `extensions['sign-in-with-x']` with `info` (domain/uri/nonce/issuedAt/expirationTime/statement) and `supportedChains` (array of {chainId, type}).
2. Agent calls pay_x402_siwx with `paymentRequiredHeader` set to the raw base64 header value (or `siwxChallenge` set to the decoded extension). Optionally pin a `chainId` from supportedChains.
3. LobsterPay signs the canonical SIWS message with the relayer ed25519 keypair and returns `signInWithXHeader`.
4. Agent retries the original URL with header `SIGN-IN-WITH-X: <signInWithXHeader>`.

5. Upstream verifies the signature (against the canonical message it reconstructs), enforces the 300s window + replay protection, and returns 200 + the API JSON response. There is no PAYMENT-RESPONSE header on SIWX flows.

usage_notes: Always call check_vault first to understand your permissions and remaining budget
All amounts are in atomic units (smallest denomination). USDC has 6 decimals: 1 USDC = 1000000
idempotencyKey is optional — omit it and the server auto-generates one. Only set it when you specifically want to retry the same action safely.
Payments are only allowed to destinations on the vault's allowlist
If a payment is rejected, check the error — it will tell you if it's a limit, allowlist, or pause issue
The vault owner can revoke your API key at any time. Handle 401 errors gracefully.
